I have the net balance for acme (27136 cents). Next, I need the net balance for birch.

The payout for acme has been recorded successfully. Next, I need to record the payout for birch.

reply.thought: The previous tool call failed because of a typo in the argument name. I need to use the correct parameter name 'amount_cents'. I will retry the record_payout for birch with the correct argument.
